About Mr. Kamulegeya Mubarak Kiggundu

A mathematics educator whose textbook reflects years of classroom teaching and department leadership.

Mr. Kamulegeya is a mathematics teacher who has held Head of Department mathematics roles. His 2025 book names teaching and leadership experience at Buddo Secondary School, Kibuli Secondary School and Lubiri Secondary School, and he is the author of Essentials of Applied Mathematics in Statistics and Numerical Methods.
